meaning.hi: यदि कोई एक मात्रा का ध्यान करे

words.sanskrit: sah tena eva samveditah turnam eva jagatyam abhisampadyate

meaning.en: by that alone he is quickly brought back into life on earth
meaning.hi: उससे ही वह शीघ्र पृथ्वी पर जीवन में लौट आता है

meaning.en: the hymns of the Rig Veda lead him to the human world
meaning.hi: ऋचाएँ उसे मनुष्यलोक तक ले जाती हैं

words.sanskrit: sah tatra tapasa brahmacharyena shraddhaya sampannah mahimanam anubhavati

meaning.en: there, endowed with discipline, celibacy, faith, he experiences greatness
meaning.hi: वहाँ तप, ब्रह्मचर्य, श्रद्धा से युक्त होकर वह महिमा अनुभव करता है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: but if he joins the mind with two sound-units
meaning.hi: पर यदि वह मन को दो मात्राओं से जोड़े

meaning.en: he is lifted by the Yajur Veda to the mid-region, to the world of the moon
meaning.hi: वह यजुर्वेद द्वारा अंतरिक्ष, सोमलोक तक उठाया जाता है

words.sanskrit: sah soma-loke vibhutim anubhuya punah avartate

meaning.en: having experienced grandeur in the lunar world, he returns again
meaning.hi: सोमलोक में भव्यता का अनुभव कर वह पुनः लौट आता है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: yah punah etam tri-matrena om iti etena eva aksharena param purusham abhidhyayita

meaning.en: whoever meditates on the supreme being using the complete three-part syllable Om
meaning.hi: जो पूर्ण त्रिमात्रा ॐ अक्षर से परम पुरुष का ध्यान करे

meaning.en: becomes filled with the radiance of the sun
meaning.hi: सूर्य के तेज से परिपूर्ण हो जाता है

meaning.en: just as a snake is freed entirely from its skin
meaning.hi: जैसे सर्प अपनी त्वचा से पूर्ण मुक्त हो जाता है

words.sanskrit: evam ha vai sah papmana vinirmuktah

meaning.en: so indeed he becomes freed from wrongdoing
meaning.hi: वैसे ही वह पाप से मुक्त हो जाता है

meaning.en: he is carried by the Sama Veda to the world of Brahman
meaning.hi: वह सामवेद द्वारा ब्रह्मलोक तक ले जाया जाता है

words.sanskrit: sah etasmat jiva-ghanat parat param purishayam purusham ikshate

meaning.en: he beholds, beyond the mass of living beings, the supreme being who dwells in the heart
meaning.hi: वह जीवघन से परे, हृदय में निवास करने वाले परम पुरुष को देखता है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: the three sound-units, tied to death when used for mortal ends
meaning.hi: तीन मात्राएँ, मर्त्य प्रयोग में मृत्युमय

meaning.en: used mutually joined, never separated
meaning.hi: परस्पर जुड़ी, कभी अलग न होतीं

meaning.en: rightly applied in outward, inward, and middle actions
meaning.hi: बाह्य, आंतरिक, और मध्य कर्मों में सम्यक् प्रयुक्त

meaning.en: the knower does not waver
meaning.hi: ज्ञानी डगमगाता नहीं

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: rigbhih etam yajurbhih antariksham sambhih yat tat kavayah vedayante

meaning.en: through Rig this world, through Yajur the mid-region, through Sama what the sages call the ultimate
meaning.hi: ऋचाओं से यह लोक, यजु से अंतरिक्ष, साम से जिसे ऋषि परम कहते हैं

words.sanskrit: tam omkarena eva ayatanena anveti vidvan

meaning.en: the wise reach that through the single support of Om
meaning.hi: ज्ञानी उसे ॐ के एक ही सहारे से पाता है

words.sanskrit: yat tat shantam ajaram amritam abhayam param cha iti

meaning.en: that which is peaceful, free of age, deathless, fearless, supreme
meaning.hi: जो शांत, अजर, अमर, अभय, परम है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: then Sukesha, son of Bharadvaja, asked him
meaning.hi: तब भारद्वाज-पुत्र सुकेशा ने उनसे पूछा

words.sanskrit: bhagavan hiranyanabhah kausalyah rajaputrah mam upetya etam prashnam apruchchhata

meaning.en: Master, prince Hiranyanabha of the Kausalya line came and asked me this question
meaning.hi: गुरुवर, कौसल्य वंश के राजकुमार हिरण्यनाभ ने मुझसे यह प्रश्न पूछा

meaning.en: do you know the sixteen-part being, Bharadvaja
meaning.hi: क्या तुम सोलह-भाग वाले पुरुष को जानते हो, भारद्वाज

words.sanskrit: tam aham kumaram abruvam na aham imam veda

meaning.en: I told that young prince, I do not know this
meaning.hi: मैंने उस राजकुमार से कहा, मैं इसे नहीं जानता

words.sanskrit: samulah va eshah parishushyati yah anritam abhivadati

meaning.en: whoever speaks falsely withers away, roots and all
meaning.hi: जो झूठ बोलता है वह जड़ सहित मुरझा जाता है

meaning.en: he silently climbed his chariot and departed
meaning.hi: वह चुपचाप रथ पर चढ़कर चला गया

words.sanskrit: tam tva pruchchhami kva asau purusha iti

meaning.en: I ask you, where is that being
meaning.hi: मैं आपसे पूछता हूँ, वह पुरुष कहाँ है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: to him he replied
meaning.hi: उससे उसने कहा

words.sanskrit: iha eva antah sharire somya sah purushah

meaning.en: right here, dear friend, within this very body, is that being
meaning.hi: यहीं, प्रिय मित्र, इसी शरीर में, वह पुरुष है

meaning.en: in whom these sixteen parts arise
meaning.hi: जिसमें ये सोलह भाग उत्पन्न होते हैं

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: that being reflected
meaning.hi: उसने विचार किया

meaning.en: by whose departure would I be said to have departed
meaning.hi: किसके निकलने से मैं निकल गया कहलाऊँगा

meaning.en: by whose remaining would I remain settled
meaning.hi: किसके स्थिर रहने से मैं स्थिर रहूँगा

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: he generated prana, and from prana, faith
meaning.hi: उसने प्राण उत्पन्न किया, प्राण से श्रद्धा

words.sanskrit: kham vayuh jyotih apah prithivi indriyam manah

meaning.en: space, air, light, water, earth, the senses, the mind
meaning.hi: आकाश, वायु, तेज, जल, पृथ्वी, इंद्रिय, मन

meaning.en: food, and from food, strength
meaning.hi: अन्न, अन्न से बल

words.sanskrit: tapah mantrah karma lokah lokeshu cha nama cha

meaning.en: discipline, sacred verses, ritual action, worlds, and names within them
meaning.hi: तप, मंत्र, कर्म, लोक, और उनमें नाम

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: sah yatha imah nadyah syandamanah samudra-ayanah

meaning.en: just as these rivers flow onward toward the ocean
meaning.hi: जैसे ये नदियाँ समुद्र की ओर बहती हैं

words.sanskrit: samudram prapya astam gachchhanti bhidyete tasam nama-rupe

meaning.en: reaching the ocean, merge and disappear, their names and forms dissolving
meaning.hi: समुद्र तक पहुँचकर विलीन हो जाती हैं, नाम-रूप घुल जाते हैं

meaning.en: it is simply called the ocean
meaning.hi: उसे बस समुद्र कहा जाता है

words.sanskrit: evam eva asya paridrashtuh imah shodasha-kalah purusha-ayanah

meaning.en: so too these sixteen parts of the witnessed one, flowing toward the being
meaning.hi: वैसे ही इस साक्षी के ये सोलह भाग, पुरुष की ओर बहते हुए

words.sanskrit: purusham prapya astam gachchhanti bhidyete cha asam nama-rupe

meaning.en: reaching the being, merge and disappear, names and forms dissolving
meaning.hi: पुरुष तक पहुँचकर विलीन हो जाते हैं, नाम-रूप घुल जाते हैं

meaning.en: it is simply called the person
meaning.hi: उसे बस पुरुष कहा जाता है

meaning.en: that being becomes whole, without parts, and deathless
meaning.hi: वह पुरुष अकल और अमर हो जाता है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: arah iva ratha-nabhau kalah yasmin pratishthitah

meaning.en: like spokes fixed in a chariot's hub, the parts fixed in him
meaning.hi: जैसे रथ की नाभि में अरे, वैसे उसमें भाग जड़े हैं

meaning.en: know this being who is truly worth knowing
meaning.hi: इस जानने योग्य पुरुष को जानो

words.sanskrit: yatha ma vah mrityuh parivyatha iti

meaning.en: so that death will not trouble you
meaning.hi: ताकि मृत्यु तुम्हें परेशान न करे

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: he said to them
meaning.hi: उसने उनसे कहा

words.sanskrit: etavat eva aham etat param brahma veda

meaning.en: this much alone I know of the supreme Brahman
meaning.hi: परम ब्रह्म के बारे में मैं बस इतना ही जानता हूँ

meaning.en: there is nothing beyond this
meaning.hi: इससे परे कुछ नहीं है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: they, honoring him with worship
meaning.hi: वे उनकी पूजा करते हुए

words.sanskrit: tvam hi nah pita yah asmakam avidyayah param param tarayasi iti

meaning.en: said, you are our father who carries us across our ignorance to the far shore
meaning.hi: कहा, आप हमारे पिता हैं जो हमारे अज्ञान से परे दूसरे तट तक पार कराते हैं

meaning.en: salutations to the great sages, salutations to the great sages
meaning.hi: महान ऋषियों को प्रणाम, महान ऋषियों को प्रणाम

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.
